name: Traffic Safety Committee Meeting
agenda_text:
AGENDA
  TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
  MEETING

Council Chambers - City Hall  Wednesday
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  September 14, 2011
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274  4:00 PM

Upon request, the agenda can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a
disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at
378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or
accommodation.

The decisions of the Traffic Safety Committee are advisory to the City Council, and the City
Council will take formal action to approve or deny said decisions at their meeting on Tuesday,
September 27, 2011. Interested persons who wish to object to the decision may speak to the
Council with their concerns. As these decisions are typically on the Consent Calendar, the person
must ask the Council during the appropriate time at the beginning of the meeting to “pull” the item
from the Consent Calendar for discussion.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

Members of the audience are invited to address the Committee at this time on items that are not
otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2, the Traffic Safety
Committee is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any item not on the agenda
unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency nature, or the need to take action
arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.

OLD BUSINESS
1. Review of Edgeline Striping on Via Zurita

NEW BUSINESS
2. Request for Turn Restrictions on Via Anita at the 100 Block of Palos Verdes Drive West

RESIDENT LETTERS
3. Request to Modify the PVHS RPZ Turn Restriction Signs from a 7:00 am - 9:00 am Time
  Period to a 6:30 am – 9:00 am Time Period.

ITEMS OF INFORMATION FROM STAFF/COMMITTEE
4. Paseo Lunado/Paseo Del Mar Speed Limit Signage

  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on all appropriate items on September 27, 2011.
 MINUTES
5. Meeting of July 13, 2011

ADJOURNMENT TO OCTOBER 12, 2011

  Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative
  formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City
Clerk at 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.

  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on all appropriate items on September 27, 2011.
minutes_text:
ACTION MEMO
  TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
  MEETING

Council Chambers - City Hall  Wednesday
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  September 14, 2011
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274  4:00 PM

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL  Committee Members Kao, Lamar, Beall, Vice-Chair Buss, and Chairman
  Friedman present.

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

OLD BUSINESS
1. Review of Edgeline Striping on Via Zurita

  Action: Recommended that staff 1) leave the edgeline striping in place, and 2) research
  options for the Committee for other signage that can be used in the area, and bring those
  options back to the Committee at the October meeting. (Approved 5-0)

NEW BUSINESS
2. Request for Turn Restrictions on Via Anita at the 100 Block of Palos Verdes Drive West.

  Action: Recommended that only the issue of a Left Turn Restriction from Via Anita onto
  Palos Verdes Drive West be brought back before the Committee in October. (Approved 5-0)

RESIDENT LETTERS
3. Request to Modify the PVHS RPZ Turn Restriction Signs from a 7:00 am – 9:00 am Time Period
  to a 6:30 am – 9:00 am Time Period

  Item to be brought back before the Committee for review in October.

ITEMS OF INFORMATION FROM STAFF/COMMITTEE
4. Paseo Lunado/Paseo Del Mar Speed Limit Signage

  Action: Staff to implement speed limit signage.

5. City Council Items of Information for the Committee.

  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on all appropriate items on Tuesday, September 27, 2011.
 MINUTES
6. Meeting of July 13, 2011

  Action: (Approved 5-0)

ADJOURNMENT TO OCTOBER 12, 2011.

  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on all appropriate items on Tuesday, September 27, 2011.
